name: Drakeeh the Unchained

abilities.name: Uppercut
abilities.description: Drakeeh winds up his greatsword before delivering a powerful blow, dealing massive physical damage and knocking you away. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Drakeeh will channel a frontal cleave with his sword, indicated by a thin but wide conical AoE. This does a massive amount of physical damage, so make sure the tank has Drakeeh taunted so they can absorb the damage. The cleave AoE adjusts to your positioning if you attempt to strafe the ability.

abilities.name: Charged Leap
abilities.description: Drakeeh will target a faraway player, leap into the air and drive his sword into the ground. Roll-dodge or block this ability; it deals a lot of physical damage damage. After he lands, stones will fly into the air around him and deal moderate physical damage to anyone nearby.

abilities.name: Void
abilities.description: Drakeeh raises his sword towards the ceiling and channels a dark spell that must be interrupted. If he is allowed to cast it, the spell will explode on the ground and send three small AoEs outward, dealing very high magical damage each.

abilities.name: Spirit Ignition
abilities.description: Drakeeh will select three wraiths for him to use in his next ability. Players must absorb the wraiths with golden circles around them and cleanse themselves at one of the ritual stones in the arena. Spirit Ignition also applies an enemy AoE around all players, as well as does some moderate initial magical damage. If player AoEs are touching when Spirit Ignition wears off after 6 seconds, then all overlapping players cause each other to take a large burst of magical damage. If a player is not touching another player's AoE, then no damage occurs.

abilities.name: Spirit Scream
abilities.description: A few moments after marking the wraiths, Drakeeh will attempt to absorb them and cause a massive explosion. If the players have cleansed all of the wraiths, this ability does little damage, but if any of the wraiths are up, this ability will deal increased damage for each wraith he has absorbed.

abilities.name: Negate
abilities.description: After Spirit Scream, Drakeeh will set a negate down around him. This ability can be very easily avoided, and deals plenty of damage while you're standing inside of it, so try not to stand in it.

abilities.name: Summon Shadow Proxies
abilities.description: Drakeeh can summon shades of himself that have all the same abilities as him, but weaker health and damage output.

related_quests: The Black Gauntlet: Enter a deadly gauntlet held by the Blackguards of Blackrose Prison.
summary: Drakeeh the Unchained is the Naga leader of the Blackguards and a descendant of one of the prisoners held at the brutal Blackrose Prison. After it was abandoned by the Imperials, Drakeeh has turned the prison into his base of operations and his gauntlet, where he pits people against his best soldiers (and then himself if they can manage to get that far) for entertainment, as well as to settle disputes with anyone who challenges his rule. He has kidnapped a former member of the Blackguards, Pimaxi-Taeed, who you must rescue during the related quest. He serves as the final boss of the arena, during Round 5: Drakeeh's Cage. He wields a two-handed greatsword and employs several magical abilities in his arsenal. He is also a devout follower of Sithis, which some posits is what grants him control over ghosts and wraiths.
